raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical units of the rectangular domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.1 and 4.1 specify a 2 × 1 domain without length units. The aspect ratio and numerical dimensions are clear.",
      "readings": [
        "2 m × 1 m",
        "2 mm × 1 mm",
        "Dimensionless 2 × 1 domain with an arbitrary reference length"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional model in Sec. 3.1 has no stated thickness. A uniform thickness scales raw compliance; the solid-normalized compliance cancels that scale.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant unit thickness",
        "Constant thickness equal to 0.01 l_y",
        "Constant thickness equal to 0.1 l_y"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Load footprint at the bottom-right corner",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 establish the nominal bottom-right corner location, but the text accompanying unavailable Fig. 6 gives no footprint or force distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force on the bottom-right corner node",
        "Uniform traction on the right edge over 0 ≤ y/l_y ≤ 0.05",
        "Uniform traction on the right edge over 0 ≤ y/l_y ≤ 0.1",
        "Triangular traction on the right edge over 0 ≤ y/l_y ≤ 0.05, largest at the corner",
        "Uniform traction on the bottom edge over 0.95 ≤ x/l_x ≤ 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Bottom-right applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The setup refers to Fig. 6, but no supplied prose or caption specifies the force direction.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward",
        "Horizontally toward the fixed left edge",
        "Diagonally downward and leftward at 45 degrees"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Resultant applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 introduces f_ext without specifying its magnitude. Uniform force scaling changes raw compliance quadratically and cancels from solid-normalized compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant magnitude 1 N",
        "Resultant magnitude 10 N",
        "Unit resultant in a consistent nondimensional system"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume bound for a standalone minimum-compliance run",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 describes branches over many volume bounds, rather than one prescribed volume fraction. Neither c_max = 5 nor Table 1's 100 continuation values selects a single run.",
      "readings": [
        "Dilated normalized volume bound epsilon_v = 0.45",
        "Dilated normalized volume bound epsilon_v = 0.60",
        "Dilated normalized volume bound epsilon_v = 0.75",
        "Run the complete continuation sequence rather than select one volume bound"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 states that the numerical examples use nu = 1/3, whereas Appendix A states that all experiments use nu = 0.3.",
      "readings": [
        "Use nu = 0.3 throughout",
        "Use nu = 1/3 throughout",
        "Use nu = 0.3 for elasticity while treating the nu = 1/3 strain-energy nucleation argument as an approximation"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies linear elasticity, and Appendix A specifies isotropy, but neither selects plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter-radius and projection-steepness combination",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Table 1 gives R = 25h for Sec. 4.1. Appendix A gives beta = 10 but also requires beta = R/(3h) or R/(5h), neither of which holds for that pair.",
      "readings": [
        "Prioritize the explicit values: R = 25h and beta = 10",
        "Keep R = 25h and use beta = 25/3",
        "Keep R = 25h and use beta = 5",
        "Keep beta = 10 and use R = 30h",
        "Keep beta = 10 and use R = 50h"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Conversion from tabulated radius to Helmholtz coefficient",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix A says R is rescaled with a sqrt(3) factor but gives no equation identifying the conversion direction or whether Table 1 reports the radius before or after rescaling.",
      "readings": [
        "In x_tilde - ell^2 Laplacian(x_tilde) = x, set ell = 25h/sqrt(3)",
        "Set ell = 25sqrt(3)h",
        "Treat the tabulated 25h as the already-rescaled PDE length ell"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Complete PDE-filter boundary conditions",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 cites consistent boundary conditions. Appendix B identifies Robin boundary neighborhoods, but supplies no Robin equation, coefficient, or complete prescription for the remaining boundary.",
      "readings": [
        "On the stated Robin portions use normal_derivative(x_tilde) + (x_tilde - 1)/ell = 0; use homogeneous Neumann conditions elsewhere",
        "Use the same prescription with Robin coefficient 2/ell instead of 1/ell",
        "Use Robin relaxation toward solid on the stated attachment neighborhoods and toward void on the remaining boundary"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Smoothed Heaviside projection formula",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 names a smoothed Heaviside projection and gives thresholds, but does not write its formula. The numerical meaning of beta therefore depends on the smoothing convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Use H(s) = [tanh(beta eta) + tanh(beta(s - eta))]/[tanh(beta eta) + tanh(beta(1 - eta))]",
        "Use the same endpoint-normalized tanh formula with beta/2 replacing beta, equivalent to an endpoint-normalized logistic with exponent beta(s - eta)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Discrete PDE filter and density transfers",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 assigns design variables to elements, but does not specify the PDE-filter discretization or transfers between element densities and filtered fields.",
      "readings": [
        "Cell-centered five-point discretization with filtered values stored at element centers",
        "Nodal first-order finite-element filter with a consistent mass matrix and averaging back to elements",
        "Nodal first-order finite-element filter with mass lumping and averaging back to elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Structural-element integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies square first-order finite elements, and Table 1 fixes their count, but the structural integration rule is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2 × 2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with one-point reduced integration and hourglass stabilization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "GCMMA state when spawning a new branch",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix A specifies carrying asymptotes and design history between continuation solves, but does not say whether that state is reset after the hole nucleation that starts another branch.",
      "readings": [
        "Reset asymptotes and design history for every newly punctured branch",
        "Inherit the GCMMA state of the parent solution that was punctured"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "KKT residual norm and normalization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix A supplies numerical KKT stopping thresholds without specifying the residual norm or normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Unscaled Euclidean norm of the KKT residual",
        "Infinity norm of the KKT residual",
        "Root-mean-square residual, dividing the Euclidean norm by the square root of the residual dimension"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology test for accepting a nucleated hole",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 requires punctures to increase genus. Appendix B instead says a puncture is accepted only if it does not change the design's topology. This affects the initial guesses used to obtain the Sec. 4.1 branches.",
      "readings": [
        "Accept only punctures that increase genus",
        "Accept only punctures that leave topology unchanged",
        "Interpret Appendix B as prohibiting unintended connectivity changes while allowing the intended genus increase"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
